tasks.description: Clarify open questions with Siva Kumar: confirm target object (Account), production deployment requirement, page layout inclusion, duplicate status with DTM-1671, FLS read-only vs read-write, and whether profiles are source-managed.

In a sandbox, create the custom text field Company_Address__c on the Account object via Setup > Object Manager > Account > Fields & Relationships. Set label 'company Address', length 255, not required, not unique, not external ID, no default value.
Configure Field-Level Security for Company_Address__c: set field visible on all standard profiles and set to read-only (or read-write per clarification).
If confirmed, add Company_Address__c to the standard Account page layout in a logical section (e.g., 'Address Information').
If profiles are not source-managed, create a permission set named 'Account_Company_Address_Read' with read access to Company_Address__c and assign it to all users (or a relevant group).
Retrieve the metadata for Company_Address__c using SFDX: `sfdx force:source:retrieve -m CustomField:Account.Company_Address__c` and save the resulting file.

If a permission set was created, retrieve its metadata using SFDX: `sfdx force:source:retrieve -m PermissionSet:Account_Company_Address_Read`. If profiles are source-managed, retrieve the relevant profile metadata with field permissions.

Commit the retrieved metadata to source control under `force-app/main/default/objects/Account/fields/Company_Address__c.field-meta.xml` (and permission set or profile files as needed). Create a feature branch named `feature/DTM-1676` and open a pull request referencing DTM-1673.

Build a deployment package using either a Change Set (outbound) or SFDX source deploy/convert. Include the field metadata, permission set (if applicable), and any profile metadata. Ensure FLS is included.
Deploy the package to the sandbox environment first. Verify deployment success.
Deploy the package to the UAT environment. Verify deployment success.
Deploy the package to the production environment. Verify deployment success.
Post-deployment validation: Run SOQL query `SELECT Id, Company_Address__c FROM Account LIMIT 1` in each target environment to confirm the field is queryable and returns no errors.

Check for naming collisions: Query FieldDefinition for Account to ensure no managed package or other custom field uses the API name Company_Address__c. Notify integration teams if any external system consumes Account data.
Run all existing Apex test classes that reference Account (e.g., AccountTriggerTest, AccountServiceTest) to confirm no regressions. Also run any Flows or validation rules involving Account.
Update Jira ticket DTM-1676 with deployment status per environment (sandbox, UAT, production), link to the pull request, and mark the ticket as done.
